title: The Choe Show
summary: A 31-second clip whose two speech captions merge what appears to be a multi-speaker mother-roleplay or mother-comparison exchange. Recoverable ideas include one person doing things “like your mother,” another resisting “Do not be my mother,” reassurance (“not you, I love you”), accusation of acting a certain way, “I don’t need a mom,” “I don’t care,” an incomplete objection, and “How was your day?” The exact turn boundaries, identities, real relationship and damaged phrase “she will pursue” remain unresolved. No idea is removed; no family biography or therapeutic narrative is invented. Zero named turns and enrollment windows ship.
